about:
Stark Electronics Inc. was founded in 1938 in New Brighton, Minnesota, as a regional distributor of electronic components. The company serves OEMs ranging from startups to Fortune 500 firms with a line card that includes brands such as Alpha Wire, Conxall, and Orion Fans. In 2024, Marsh Electronics acquired Stark to expand its product portfolio and strengthen its presence in the industrial electronics market, providing Stark with enhanced distribution capabilities and access to a broader customer base.

Through its subsidiary Absolute Quality Manufacturing (AQM), Stark offers custom electrical solutions. AQM produces custom wire harnesses up to 100 feet in length with connectors from Deutsch, Amphenol, and MIL‑STD, as well as cable assemblies ranging from 30 AWG to 4/0 and multi‑conductor cables. The shop also builds terminal block and DIN rail assemblies using franchised lines like Dinkle, UL 508A certified electrical control panels, electro‑mechanical assemblies, and turn‑key panel and box builds.

The combined organization serves the automotive, agriculture, and transportation industries, among others. Its customer base includes OEMs in sectors that require ruggedized cable assemblies for fertilizer sensors, transportation systems, and agricultural equipment.

Stark emphasizes a commitment to quality and customer satisfaction built on decades of experience. The company states that it continuously invests in staff training and cutting‑edge technology to remain at the forefront of the industry, and that its in‑house function testing ensures each assembly meets exacting demands.
